notes: tapFrac is the real centre of a real rect, converted with the two constants this template forces. The CanvasScaler is Expand at 1242x2688, so on the 1080x2400 capture device the logical canvas is 1242x2760, and under each canvas an AspectRatioFitter pins the panel space back to 1242x2688 centred, i.e. letterboxed by 36 logical units top and bottom. Hence fracX = x_in_panel / 1242 and fracY = (36 + y_from_panel_top) / 2760. Every step changes the screen; no two frames show the same thing.
